description: Fetch a normalized statement with DQ overlay/anomalies.

accession_id.description: SEC accession of the filing whose statement to read, as returned by /v1/edgar/companies/{cik}/statements. With cik, statement_type, fiscal_year and fiscal_period it names one public statement.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year for the statement identity.

statement_date.description: End date of the statement's period (YYYY-MM-DD). Needed only when the filing reports two OTHER periods in the fiscal year (a year split at a business combination or fresh-start reorganization); without it the call fails with EDGAR_STATEMENT_AMBIGUOUS listing the dates.

name: dq_anomalies
